article_notes: Case series of 49 dogs with autochthonous B. canis (PCR and sequencing) in Berlin/Brandenburg; 46 seen at the Freie Universitaet Berlin clinic with complete records, 3 in a practice. Descriptive statistics only; no statistical tests against outcome. 7 of 46 dogs died (3) or were euthanised (4) within 2-18 days. Only two outcome-related statements with numbers: SIRS at presentation among dogs that died/were euthanised, and death among dogs with persistent azotaemia. Values at initial presentation; timing relative to imidocarb not stated.

severity_definitions.label: died or euthanised vs survived
severity_definitions.definition: Dogs that died (3) or were euthanised (4; including financial reasons with acute renal failure) vs 39 survivors among the 46 clinic dogs.
severity_definitions.quote: Thirty‐nine dogs (85%) survived. Four dogs were euthanized after 2 to 18 days

associations.marker_as_reported: SIRS criteria fulfilled at initial presentation
associations.statistic: SIRS in 3 of 7 dogs that died or were euthanised; 13 dogs with SIRS survived (SIRS present in 16 of 43 assessed dogs)
associations.quote: Systemic inflammatory response syndrome occurred in 3 of 7 of the dogs that died or were euthanized in our study, whereas 13 dogs with SIRS survived B. canis infection.
associations.location: Discussion, para 8 (also Results, Treatment and outcome)
associations.note: SIRS assessed in 43 dogs; the denominator for survivors is not printed, so no comparison percentage is given. SIRS = >=2 of temperature, heart rate, respiratory rate, leukocyte criteria. Owner: marker recoded from Clinical severity score to SIRS status (agreement review).

associations.statistic: 5 of 17 dogs with persistently increased creatinine died or were euthanised
associations.quote: Five of 17 dogs with persistently increased serum creatinine concentrations died or were euthanized, respectively.
associations.note: Reported as the outcome among azotaemic dogs, not as azotaemia frequency by outcome group; no values for non-azotaemic dogs printed.
